units.rawText: Night falls. By the order of Master Yagyu, Dupin will be spending the night in a guest room on the estate.
units.displayText: Night falls. By the order of Master Yagyu, Dupin will be spending the night in a guest room on the estate.

units.rawText: The exhibition is tomorrow. However, Dupin stays up well into the night, going over information and plans inside his suite.
units.displayText: The exhibition is tomorrow. However, Dupin stays up well into the night, going over information and plans inside his suite.

units.rawText: A rematch with LeBlanc, hm...
units.displayText: A rematch with LeBlanc, hm...

spans.text: A rematch with LeBlanc, hm...

units.displayText: The security systems and personnel are largely mechanical in nature. While they're hardly smart devices, they're highly resistant to the electronic disruption that LeBlanc favors...

spans.text: The security systems and personnel are largely mechanical in nature. While they're hardly smart devices, they're highly resistant to the electronic disruption that LeBlanc favors...

units.rawText: (I checked all the security Dolls at the venue while doing my inspection today. In theory, all the exits are secure, and the raising and lowering of the canopy can be done by hand...)
units.displayText: I checked all the security Dolls at the venue while doing my inspection today. In theory, all the exits are secure, and the raising and lowering of the canopy can be done by hand...

units.rawText: Ding. His communicator suddenly goes off, the sound of its alert particularly crisp in the silence.
units.displayText: Ding. His communicator suddenly goes off, the sound of its alert particularly crisp in the silence.

spans.text: Ding. His communicator suddenly goes off, the sound of its alert particularly crisp in the silence.

units.rawText: A feeling of foreboding fills Dupin's heart as he answers.
units.displayText: A feeling of foreboding fills Dupin's heart as he answers.

spans.text: A feeling of foreboding fills Dupin's heart as he answers.

units.rawText: <color=red>Do you think this counts as our first time exchanging contact information?</color>
units.displayText: Do you think this counts as our first time exchanging contact information?

spans.text: Do you think this counts as our first time exchanging contact information?

units.rawText: <color=red>—Dupin?</color>
units.displayText: —Dupin?

spans.text: —Dupin?

units.rawText: ...<color=orange>LeBlanc.</color>
units.displayText: ...LeBlanc.

spans.text: LeBlanc.

units.rawText: <color=red>I expected nothing less of the great detective. You immediately realized it was me—it would seem you received my invitation.</color>
units.displayText: I expected nothing less of the great detective. You immediately realized it was me—it would seem you received my invitation.

spans.text: I expected nothing less of the great detective. You immediately realized it was me—it would seem you received my invitation.

units.rawText: Did you call me at this hour just to wax nostalgic?
units.displayText: Did you call me at this hour just to wax nostalgic?

spans.text: Did you call me at this hour just to wax nostalgic?

units.rawText:
LeBlanc speaks in a leisurely tone, like a violin chord echoing through the night.
Dupin subconsciously tightens his grip around his cane, focusing all his efforts on trying to discern LeBlanc's plan as opposed to going around in circles with him.

units.rawText: <color=red>Oh, how cold. You ought to be more romantic. That would make you more interesting.</color>
units.displayText: Oh, how cold. You ought to be more romantic. That would make you more interesting.

spans.text: Oh, how cold. You ought to be more romantic. That would make you more interesting.

units.rawText: You sound like you have a great deal of confidence in your little show tomorrow.
units.displayText: You sound like you have a great deal of confidence in your little show tomorrow.

spans.text: You sound like you have a great deal of confidence in your little show tomorrow.

units.rawText: <color=red>—Tomorrow?</color>
units.displayText: —Tomorrow?

spans.text: —Tomorrow?

units.rawText: <color=red>Surely the curtains have already risen on the thrilling opening act, no?</color>
units.displayText: Surely the curtains have already risen on the thrilling opening act, no?

spans.text: Surely the curtains have already risen on the thrilling opening act, no?

units.rawText: You're trying to get me to ask you a question. What do you want to say?
units.displayText: You're trying to get me to ask you a question. What do you want to say?

spans.text: You're trying to get me to ask you a question. What do you want to say?

units.rawText: <color=red>"A rose by any other name would still smell as sweet."</color>
units.displayText: "A rose by any other name would still smell as sweet."

spans.text: "A rose by any other name would still smell as sweet."

units.rawText: <color=red>And more than one show can take place on the same stage.</color>
units.displayText: And more than one show can take place on the same stage.

spans.text: And more than one show can take place on the same stage.

units.rawText: <color=red>I wonder... Will you be able to catch up to me this time?</color>
units.displayText: I wonder... Will you be able to catch up to me this time?

spans.text: I wonder... Will you be able to catch up to me this time?

units.rawText: Ding.
units.displayText: Ding.

spans.text: Ding.

units.rawText: The call cuts off right after that one-sided announcement that sounded more like a prank than a conversation. Dupin swiftly takes stock of the current situation, reaches a conclusion on what LeBlanc is trying to do, and immediately calls the organizer to verify it.
units.displayText: The call cuts off right after that one-sided announcement that sounded more like a prank than a conversation. Dupin swiftly takes stock of the current situation, reaches a conclusion on what LeBlanc is trying to do, and immediately calls the organizer to verify it.

units.rawText: The Juuzumaru Tsunetsugu? It's fine. We didn't spot LeBlanc.
units.displayText: The Juuzumaru Tsunetsugu? It's fine. We didn't spot LeBlanc.

spans.text: The Juuzumaru Tsunetsugu? It's fine. We didn't spot LeBlanc.

units.rawText: Just in case, please patch a live feed of the exhibit through to me.
units.displayText: Just in case, please patch a live feed of the exhibit through to me.

spans.text: Just in case, please patch a live feed of the exhibit through to me.

units.rawText: Sure, no problem... See? Safe as houses.
units.displayText: Sure, no problem... See? Safe as houses.

spans.text: Sure, no problem... See? Safe as houses.

units.rawText: [(╬￣皿￣) What happened!?]
units.displayText: [(╬￣皿￣) What happened!?]

spans.text: [(╬￣皿￣) What happened!?]

units.rawText: [⊙０⊙ What happened!? What's going on!?]
units.displayText: [⊙０⊙ What happened!? What's going on!?]

spans.text: [⊙０⊙ What happened!? What's going on!?]

units.rawText: We're going to check all the security measures again!
units.displayText: We're going to check all the security measures again!

spans.text: We're going to check all the security measures again!

units.rawText: [Σ(☉▽☉ Move out! Protect the exhibit!]
units.displayText: [Σ(☉▽☉ Move out! Protect the exhibit!]

spans.text: [Σ(☉▽☉ Move out! Protect the exhibit!]

units.rawText: ...Thank you.
units.displayText: ...Thank you.

spans.text: ...Thank you.

units.rawText: There'll be lots of big names attending the exhibition this time round, so we'll have a lot on our plates. Still, we'll do our best.
units.displayText: There'll be lots of big names attending the exhibition this time round, so we'll have a lot on our plates. Still, we'll do our best.

spans.text: There'll be lots of big names attending the exhibition this time round, so we'll have a lot on our plates. Still, we'll do our best.

units.rawText: ...Looks like there's nothing wrong with the exhibition hall.
units.displayText: ...Looks like there's nothing wrong with the exhibition hall.

spans.text: ...Looks like there's nothing wrong with the exhibition hall.

units.rawText: Was LeBlanc just pranking me? No, given my understanding of him...
units.displayText: Was LeBlanc just pranking me? No, given my understanding of him...

spans.text: Was LeBlanc just pranking me? No, given my understanding of him...

units.rawText: No, I need to head to the exhibition hall just in case, and contact Aki ASAP...
units.displayText: No, I need to head to the exhibition hall just in case, and contact Aki ASAP...

spans.text: No, I need to head to the exhibition hall just in case, and contact Aki ASAP...

units.displayText: ...Considering the time...
